item.title: A message from Guidance:
item.description: At STA, we have a partnership with the Canadian Armed Forces to offer a High School Co-op Program. They will be visiting tomorrow during period 4 to discuss the co-op Program, career opportunities, training, and the application process. If you're interested in attending, you must sign up in the Guidance office by the end of the day today.

item.title: A Message From Mme. Perron.
item.description: Mme Perron, Mme. Bourdon, Mr Kwok, Mrs. Zurawski and Ms Montgomery want to take a minute to thank all Europe Travelers and any staff and students who helped support our trip in April by attending our Trivia Night this past Saturday Evening. The event was a huge success and we would like to thank everyone for their continued support. Travelers are reminded of the team meeting tomorrow at 10:40 in preparation for the team logo and hoodie fittings this meeting will not be long please be on time.

item.title: A message from Ms. Baron and Ms.Clune:
item.description: A reminder to all junior and senior boys interested in playing basketball this season, we will have our first tryout after school tomorrow from 2:30-3:30. See you there!

item.title: A message from Mr. Vonesch:
item.description: All members of the music ministry team, please note that there will be a practice today at lunch in the chapel.

item.title: A message from Mr. Warner:
item.description: Please wish the junior girls' basketball team luck tonight for their exhibition game against the PRBC Rockets U19 team. Game time is 745 pm at St. FX in Hammond.

item.title: A message from: Mme Laneville:
item.description: Grade 10 French immersion students are reminded to register for the Winter Carnival Cultural trip to Quebec city by today October 19th to reserve your spot. If you have any questions, please see Mme Laneville today!

item.title: A message from M. Décoste:
item.description: Signup sheets along with tryout dates for 7/8 Volleyball have been posted on the Athletic board near stairwell.

item.title: A message from Mrs. Kwok:
item.description: There will be no Unity Club meeting today. Please check the Teams page later today for information.

item.title: A message from: Mrs. Longval
item.description: Attention students in Grades 9–12! Looking to get a workout in? The weight room will be open at the following times this week:Monday & Wednesday: 10:40–11:20 AM (Lunch) | All studentsTuesday: 2:20–3:30 PM (After School) | All studentsThursday: 10:40–11:20 AM (Lunch) | Female students onlyFriday: CLOSED as Mrs. Longval is away with the Varsity Football Team.New to the weight room? If you have not yet attended an orientation session, please sign up and bring in your signed Weight Room Waiver and Consent Form before participating. All fitness levels are welcome! Please stop by to chat with Mrs. Longval if you have any questions.
